name: Little Investigators Summer Program (Nashua YMCA Day Camps)
description_short: A half-day preschool summer camp for ages 3-5 at the Nashua YMCA. It runs Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 1 PM, with a new theme each week, such as nature, water play, science and dinosaurs, and swim time once a week.
special_needs_notes: Children must be potty trained to attend.
swim_waterfront_notes: Children swim once per week in the Nashua Y pool. Week 2 includes water play such as sprinklers and bubbles.
